title: Order board (a partner page)
description: The partner's order board, framed by the shop: a Deliveries key on the till opens it as a sheet over the sale, and in Desk it opens as a page for a record. The shop opens it with a signed, one-time context; on the till the board answers once, server to server, with the sale's delivery order number (a sale detail this app installs). Who may open it in Desk: Stock User and Stock Manager. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes its own.
